failure.body:

1. keep shut/unshut cycle in the T1 device.

resolution.title: feat: add bgp shutdown test
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Add a new test case to
1. analyze the cease message when DUT's neighbor shuts down the BGP session
2. confirm the bgp session is properly closed
3. confirm the announced route is cleared
